name: ai-collab
description: Team marketplace: shared Claude Code plugins (skills, subagents, hooks) for AI-assisted multi-repo collaboration on GitHub.

plugins.name: team-ai-workflow
plugins.description: Guard-rail hooks (protected paths, no commits on main, no force-push to shared branches, auto-format), skills (polish-writing, polish-ui, design, check-overlap, implement-issue, create-pr, review-pr, fix-ci, split-pr, triage-issue, write-adr, onboard) and review subagents.

plugins.name: team-ai-community
plugins.description: Opt-in skills contributed by team members (lighter review). Promote to team-ai-workflow once the team relies on one.
